user.description: Browse Quran recitations from mp3quran.net in the Home Assistant media browser.

data_description.display_language: Language used for reciter, moshaf, and surah names in Media Browser. Sorting follows this language.

data_description.favorite_reciters: Shown at the top of the MP3 Quran media source. Available after the reciter catalog has loaded.
